prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished WORLD MAP IMAGE for the original children's educational social game 'Mundo dos Ursos'. New illustration; the four supplied images are STYLE AND LANDMARK REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. It must capture this specific game world rather than a generic fantasy map. Wide 16:9 landscape, one complete coherent island seen from an elevated three-quarter bird's-eye view, like a beautiful tactile miniature/diorama with gentle 3D volume, rounded terrain, visible shore cliffs, dimensional buildings, soft contact shadows, and clean cartoon outlines. Friendly moderately realistic cartoon proportions, crisp readable silhouettes, warm rich colors, no photorealism or plastic toy sheen. Fill most of the frame with the island, surrounded by brilliant turquoise sea, foam, small reefs, and a few tiny islands. Keep every major district clearly separated and recognizable at game-map scale. REQUIRED GEOGRAPHY: CENTER is the bear town plaza, a circular paved square with the recognizable two-tier fountain from reference 1, benches, shrubs and a few tiny brown bears with a little flying-fish pet; NORTH/UPPER CENTER is the commercial district on a small grassy terrace, with two adjacent colorful storefronts (pink cosmetics shop with purple roof matching reference 3 and a pet shop), the small food truck and two umbrella tables; WEST/LEFT is a lush bamboo grove with the wooden dojo matching reference 2, stone path, bamboo fences and lanterns; EAST/RIGHT is the science forest, with a whimsical WOODEN TREE-TRUNK ROCKET at a small launch clearing, warm green forest canopy and a simple observatory detail; SOUTH/LOWER CENTER is a snowy glacial peninsula with the recognizable wooden sailing ship from reference 4 docked beside ice, two tiny lifeboats, glaciers, and small frozen mammoth and saber-toothed-cat ice exhibits. Integrate these five districts into ONE continuous island with attractive winding paths connecting the central plaza to each district, small bridges where useful, gentle hills and harmonious terrain transitions. The snowy port must be on the island's lower coast, with ample sea around the ship; it should not cover the plaza. Tiny bear inhabitants and subtle flags/lamps may add life, but landmarks and routes must remain clean and uncluttered. Leave a little breathing room around the district centers for engine-rendered labels. No text of any kind, no title, no signs with writing, no labels, no numbered nodes, no XP or currency counters, no UI, no compass overlay, no watermark. This is the reusable background art for a clickable in-game map.
